tools.name: search_festivals
tools.description: Festivals in South Korea that run during a date range (default: today to 30 days ahead, KST), optionally filtered by province, keyword and free admission, soonest first. Returns name, dates, status, region, venue, free/paid, a short summary and the kfestivals page. Exhibitions and shows running long

tools.name: get_festival
tools.description: Full details of one festival by id (from search_festivals or get_festival_picks): dates, venue and address with coordinates, admission and price, description, organizer, phone, official website, image and the kfestivals page.

tools.name: search_concerts
tools.description: K-pop, idol, band and other popular-music concerts in South Korea registered with KOPIS (the national performing-arts box office database), not yet ended, soonest first. Filter by artist or title keyword, province and dates. Returns dates, venue, poster, the KOPIS page and the kfestivals page.

tools.name: get_festival_picks
tools.description: kfestivals' latest weekly article — the festivals and concerts worth going to this week — and its 'festival trail' 2-day routes that link 2–4 nearby festivals by day. Returns the article text, the listed events with dates and pages, and the article page.
